description: Version control for analysis code — everyday git, branches, undoing mistakes, and the GitHub CLI

cheats.title: Stage only some changes, piece by piece
cheats.notes: y = stage this chunk, n = skip, s = split it smaller, q = done

cheats.title: What did I change (not staged yet)
What's staged for the next commit
Find when some code appeared or vanished
See a file as it was in an old commit
New branch and switch to it
Push a new branch to GitHub
Delete a local branch
cheats.notes: -D forces it even if it isn't merged

cheats.title: Merge a branch into the current one
Update my branch on top of main
cheats.cmd: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

cheats.title: Copy one commit onto this branch
Throw away edits to a file
cheats.notes: Can't be undone — the edits are gone

cheats.title: Fix the last commit message
cheats.notes: Only before pushing — after that it rewrites shared history

cheats.title: Add a forgotten file to the last commit
Undo the last commit, keep the changes
Undo a commit that's already pushed
cheats.notes: Makes a new commit that reverses it — safe for shared branches

cheats.title: Park changes for later
cheats.notes: git stash list to see them, git stash pop to bring the latest back

cheats.title: Get back a 'lost' commit
cheats.notes: Find the commit there, then  git switch -c rescue <hash>

cheats.title: Bail out of a merge or rebase
Stop tracking a file but keep it on disk
cheats.notes: Add it to .gitignore too, or it'll come back

cheats.title: Preview deleting untracked files
cheats.notes: Looks right? Then  git clean -fd  actually deletes them

cheats.title: Point the repo at a new URL
Keep a fork in sync with the original
cheats.cmd:
git remote add upstream {{original_url}}
git fetch upstream && git merge upstream/main

cheats.title: Tag a release
cheats.cmd: git tag -a v{{version:1.0.0}} -m "{{message}}" && git push origin --tags

cheats.title: Put an existing folder on GitHub (no gh)
cheats.cmd:
git init && git add -A && git commit -m "first commit"
git branch -M main && git remote add origin {{url}} && git push -u origin main

cheats.title: Set your name and email
cheats.cmd:
git config --global user.name "{{name}}"
git config --global user.email "{{email}}"

cheats.title: Keep big data files out of the repo
cheats.notes: For big files you DO want versioned, use Git LFS:  git lfs track "*.h5"

cheats.title: Make an SSH key and add it to GitHub
Create a GitHub repo from this folder
Open a pull request
cheats.notes: --fill uses your commit messages; add --draft for a draft PR

cheats.title: Squash-merge a PR and delete its branch
Watch the latest Actions run
cheats.notes: gh run list  shows recent runs
